Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step, the WebSurfer agent failed to correctly disambiguate the name "Wanderley Oliveira." The search results contained two distinct individuals: a Brazilian boxer born in 1988 and a private individual (likely from a people-search site like MyLife.com) born in 1942. The agent incorrectly selected the boxer (born 1988) as the primary subject without verifying if this was the intended individual or if the older person (born 1942) was the relevant match. If the question referred to the boxer, the answer stands, but if it referred to the older individual found in the search results, the agent made an error by ignoring the 1942 birth date which would have made Wanderley Oliveira the one born first. The agent should have investigated the context or the older candidate more thoroughly before concluding.
